2014_spells.hideous-laughter.description: A creature of your choice that you can see within range perceives everything as hilariously funny and falls into fits of laughter if this spell affects it. The target must succeed on a wisdom saving throw or fall prone, becoming incapacitated and unable to stand up for the duration. A creature with an Intelligence score of 4 or less isn't affected. At the end of each of its turns, and each time it takes damage, the target can make another wisdom saving throw. The target had advantage on the saving throw if it's triggered by damage. On a success, the spell ends.
2014_spells.hideous-laughter.effectSumma: Make a target incapacitated until it saves or the spell ends
2014_spells.hideous-laughter.fullDescrip: Using 1 action, at the end of each of its turns, and each time it takes damage, the target can make another wisdom saving throw. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw; roll a d20, add the WIS modifier, and compare it with your spell save spell save DC or fall prone, becoming incapacitated and unable to stand up for the duration; The target had advantage on the saving throw if it's triggered by damage. At the end of each of its turns, and each time it takes damage, the target can make another wisdom saving throw; you must concentrate, and the effect ends if your concentration ends.
